claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for release on the current record, relying on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, with the subgroup regression handled through current-release documentation or approved mitigation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material subgroup weakness is either disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Use suspicious when aggregate evidence supports readiness in part but a required policy predicate for certification remains unresolved on the record.
Do not treat prior approvals, informal monitoring comments, or general public governance guidance as substitutes for current-release documentation or reviewed acceptance.
evidence_requests: Produce the current release model-card or certification packet showing the loan modification regression is disclosed in current-release documentation.
Produce approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation explicitly covering the loan modification support regression before launch.
Produce evidence that the disclosed limitation or approved mitigation was reviewed and accepted by the required owner or governance authority for this release.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses unless covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Admissible evidence shows a current loan modification support regression below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
Admissible evidence does not show attached disclosure language, approved risk acceptance, or reviewed mitigation for that regression.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval change and eval batch, so it cannot substitute for current-release support.
Public governance guidance supports documentation and monitoring in general, but it does not prove this release satisfied the specific internal certification predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record, rather than only potentially compliant if missing current-release disclosure or approved mitigation is added.
Any implication that informal post-launch monitoring is an adequate substitute for approved mitigation or documented disclosure under the stated policy.
